newsitem.title: USA: Post Properties cuts interest rate on debt.
newsitem.headline: Post Properties cuts interest rate on debt.

text.p: Post Properties Inc said on Thursday that the maturity date on its $180 million unsecured revolving line of credit has been extended to April 30, 2000, and the interest rate on the facility has been reduced to LIBOR plus 0.675 percent.

Included in the credit facility is a money market competitive bid option program which allows the participating banks to bid for short-term funds (up to 180 days) for up to $90 million at rates below the contracted line rate, Post Properties said.
The average blended rate obtained in the first bid/auction was LIBOR + 0.56 percent or 6.25 percent, which matures May 10, 1997, Post Properties said.
The agent for the credit facility is Wachovia Bank of Georgia with First Union National Bank of Georgia serving as co-agent, Post Properties said.
Previous terms of the credit facility were not immediately available.
